pages.title: The water's own
text: Everything that belongs to the Shallows lives in its water: three gentle swimmers, and a moray that hunts there at night. See [the March](the_march) for the land itself.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Silt Glider
text: A ray that glides over the silt, in groups of two to four. **14 health** and **1 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Silt Fins**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Pale Drifter
text: An amber sea nettle with a striped bell, trailing long ribbon arms, in groups of two to four. **12 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Shoal Darter
text: A little striped perch, in groups of two to four. **14 health** and **1 armour**.

pages.title: Brine Lurker
text: A moray eel that rises in the Shallows at night, one or two at a time. It has **21 health** and **1 armour**, and its bite does **4** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Brine Fangs**, a Venom reagent. Brine Fangs call the Tide Drummer at the Tide Stone: see [guardians](guardians).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Silt Glider**: 1 to 2 Raw Glimmerfin and up to 1 Bone Meal. Breed with **Ribbon Weed or seagrass**.
- **Pale Drifter**: up to 1 Drift Jelly and up to 1 Slimeball. Breed with **Ribbon Weed or seagrass**.
- **Shoal Darter**: 1 to 2 Raw Glimmerfin and up to 1 Bone Meal. Breed with **Ribbon Weed or seagrass**.
- **Brine Lurker**: up to 2 Ink Sacs and up to 1 Raw Glimmerfin.
